title: Disintermediation Governance and Complementor Innovation: An Empirical Look at Amazon.com
authors: Xia Han; Gaoyang Cai; Grace Gu
eligible_reason: Not staggered and no data. The Amazon Communication Guideline change has one implementation date: 1. processing.do sets Post2 = (week >= 9) for every seller (or listeddate >= implementdate). Treatment intensity comes from time-invariant seller exposure (website, Directc, channelpay, continuous Lnoverlap) interacted with Post2. Main Tables 3-5 (reghdfe ... Post2_website $xlist [pweight=cem_weights], absorb(seller week)) also include time-varying seller controls (review count, rating, list price) and CEM probability weights; moderation tables add subgroup-by-treatment interactions.
design_notes: Seller-week panel of Amazon third-party sellers matched (CEM) on pre-period characteristics; treatment = sellers with direct selling channels (website / direct contact / channel payment / overlap), post = after the guideline change (week 9). Mechanism tables use eBay and sellers' own websites.
estimators_reported: common-date 2x2 DiD with seller and week FE, CEM pweights and time-varying controls
data_files_note: README: 'The datasets used in our paper are proprietary data purchased from third-party companies.' Only do-files, logs, tables and figures shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Single policy date; CEM-weighted DiD with controls; no data.
